reassess/r_3.md:5139:本地 exp109 的原始记录比当前叙述更细：oracle support bank 上界是强阳性，但它用 GT same-ID prototype，是“知道目标身份以后怎么补”的上界；这正是 donor-source-separation 必须绕开的墙。真正的 kill-switch 不能只测“泄漏能不能被检测”，必须在 frozen 特征上直接测“无 GT 身份、只按遮挡源压制后，排序是否上升”。
reassess/r_3.md:5143:# GOPL 零训练 kill-switch 设计（2026-06-24, B containment 死后转向; novelty 7/10 存活）
reassess/r_3.md:5146:> 大家以为跨视角/遮挡 ReID 难在"特征对齐不够"，其实是 **正样本关系粒度错了**：ReID 训练把同一 ID 的所有 pair 当**等价**正样本强拉近，但两张图**共同可观测的人体表面**可能几乎不重叠（一张遮腿一张遮躯干→共同只剩头），此时"同一身份"是**过强监督**，会把不可对齐的远程正边硬拉，污染 identity manifold。
reassess/r_3.md:5152:- 论文**能写**: "revisit supervised ReID from positive-relation granularity"; "same-ID labels correct but not uniformly reliable under disjoint visible surfaces"; "SMPL only as geometry reliability meter, not identity rep / alignment"。
reassess/r_3.md:5155:## 零训练 kill-switch（先验隐藏变量存在 + 证 SMPL 几何独特）
reassess/r_3.md:5157:数据 occluded_duke（SMPL 缓存现成）。冻结一个**强 occluded_duke ReID ckpt**（agent 找最强的, 如 exp255/PSG 系或 exp341base; 报 mAP sanity）。SMPL: `cache/smpl_geom/{train,query,gallery}.npz` = 71 关节 pj2d(2D)+j3d(3D)+conf+valid。
reassess/r_3.md:5162:- `cov3d(i,j)` = 用 j3d + 相机朝向估每关节"表面是否朝向相机可见"（自遮挡), 再算共同可见 IoU（**这才是 GOPL 主张的 SMPL-3D**, 若 verts 需要 agent 按需重算 ROMP mesh; 关节级先做近似）。
reassess/r_3.md:5172:- D2 **bbox/相机对** 当 overlap 代理 → SMPL cov 必须解释更多(更高 Spearman / 更大桶 gap)。
reassess/r_3.md:5181:- 核心1-4 不成立(距离与 cov 无关): 整个"正样本关系粒度"假设错, 换方向。

reassess/r_3.md:6127:./reassess.sh:10:- **死2(刚)**: GOPL'正样本关系粒度错了'(用 SMPL 共同可见人体表面 overlap 当 same-ID 正边可靠性)。冻结最强 occluded_duke ckpt(exp255, sanity mAP73.05≈训练73.2)测: cosine 距离确实弱负相关 overlap(rho≈-0.13)但: D5 随机关节子集打平(-0.1294≈真-0.1273)、cov2d 控住可见关节数后归零(+0.0145)、#vis 关节数 baseline 反而更强(-0.1321)、相机对(视角差)解释方差 eta²0.062 比 SMPL cov 0.018 还大、cov3d(3D自遮挡)没明显强于 cov2d → 隐藏变量是'遮挡越重越难'(occlusion-count)不是'共同可见表面', SMPL 几何=VPM/QPM/occlusion-count 换名无独特信号。
reassess/r_3.md:6128:./reassess.sh:12:**残酷 meta-pattern**: 团队'独有资产'SMPL/人体几何**反复 reduce to 廉价代理**——exp333 SMPL-β≈random、pose 融 CLIP 五角度全死、SMPL-anchor VI-ReID 死、GOPL cov≈occlusion-count+view-diff。**SMPL 对 ReID 没有超出 occlusion-count/视角的独特判别信号。** 团队三大资产全弱: ①SMPL/几何(反复证伪) ②遮挡 ReID(历史5死角+三堵墙 completion/occluder-gate/visibility, exp109 oracle headroom 是 identity-conditioned 不可实现的墙) ③航拍-地面(ViSA/GSAlign/SeCap/DTST 占满+转 video/challenge)。**真的硬资产只有强 Swin/SOLIDER backbone**(occluded_duke 73.2 / CARGO 67.3)但那是 backbone 非方法。可用数据: occluded_duke / market / MSMT17 / CARGO / AG-ReID.v2 / occluded_reid。
reassess/r_3.md:6129:./reassess.sh:19:ROLES[3]="角色=**遮挡最后一搏**。p_3提的遮挡source-separation(occlusion=别人身份污染target embedding, donor-ID泄漏)值不值得测? 但必须面对历史'occluder-gate是墙'(exp109: 即使gate掉遮挡, headroom是identity-conditioned不可实现)。设计**最锋利最便宜的kill-switch, 且必须同时回答'压制donor-ID泄漏能不能真涨ReID'**(不只是证泄漏存在——泄漏存在但压了不涨=撞墙=没用)。联网查novelty(撞TTPM/non-target-pedestrian-occlusion那批没)。如果连这都救不动或必撞墙, 诚实说'遮挡这块彻底关'。"

reassess/r_3.md:6495:./pivot/p_3.md:2011:## ★★★ 最强收敛发现:同框"入侵身份泄漏"(co-present identity leakage)
reassess/r_3.md:6497:./pivot/p_3.md:2015:Occluded-Duke 的遮挡**大比例是"另一个行人"而非物体**。全领域(167篇)把遮挡当"信息缺失→补全(completion/pose/part/CLIP)"。**真正失败不是缺信息, 而是 target embedding 被遮挡那个人的身份污染**——一个 distractor identity 泄漏进来。这是 source-separation 问题, 与全场"补全"范式正交。**没有一篇这么做。**
reassess/r_3.md:6502:./pivot/p_3.md:2023:- **★廉价 kill-switch(一晚)**: 合成人遮挡上, 用强 baseline(Swin-Small)embedding 训入侵者-ID 探针。≈随机→强主干已抑制无泄漏可挖→kill; >>随机→有故事。
reassess/r_3.md:6503:./pivot/p_3.md:2026:reid-paper 项目 D4 诊断**已确认 donor-leakage 人际混淆在强主干仍持续(≈3×物体干扰)**——kill-switch 其实已经过了。衍生"donor-leakage 反事实一致性"方法 6-7/10、待探针。**库读证明: 你这条自己的活口, 正好是整个领域的空白。**
reassess/r_3.md:6507:./pivot/p_3.md:2045:**领域(167篇)+ 你自己的 D4 诊断 + 获胜配方 三方收敛到同一个角度: 同框入侵身份泄漏的 source-separation(非补全)。** 这是 reid-paper 项目最强活口, 也是全领域空白, 且自带打 wall-2 的对照 + 一晚的 kill-switch。下一步: 核对"主要人物归属"当年判死理由 → 不撞则跑探针 → 建 donor-leakage 反事实一致性方法。
reassess/r_3.md:6508:./pivot/p_3.md:2120:3. **SMPL 数据/提取=症结**：单图低分辨率遮挡 crop 上 ROMP 的 10-d 体型 β 被相机/姿态噪声主导、与细粒度身份无关 + 主动稀释外观。

reassess/r_3.md:6521:./analyses/deep_16.txt:31:3. 机制怎么长出来：如果接受“遮挡是特征污染”，扩散式去噪补全就很自然。DDO 用冻结 ViT 的干净特征作监督，把遮挡特征恢复成干净特征。HRR 则利用身份中心先筛候选，再做局部重排序。不过 HRR 依赖闭集身份结构，协议风险比 DDO 大。
reassess/r_3.md:6522:./analyses/deep_16.txt:32:4. 证据闭环：证据比较直接。可视化显示 DDO 把注意力从白墙、遮挡物拉回衣服、脸和可见身体；MSE、余弦误差和 SSIM 显示补全后特征更接近干净特征；DDO 插到 TransReID 和 Pass-ViT 也有增益。HRR 的证据更复杂，Occluded-Duke 上 mAP 从 81.8 到 90.6，但 Occluded-ReID 上会从 92.3 降到 90.1，作者也承认图库身份样本少或重遮挡时中心会偏。

reassess/r_3.md:7342:./reassess/r_1.md:16:- **死2(刚)**: GOPL'正样本关系粒度错了'(用 SMPL 共同可见人体表面 overlap 当 same-ID 正边可靠性)。冻结最强 occluded_duke ckpt(exp255, sanity mAP73.05≈训练73.2)测: cosine 距离确实弱负相关 overlap(rho≈-0.13)但: D5 随机关节子集打平(-0.1294≈真-0.1273)、cov2d 控住可见关节数后归零(+0.0145)、#vis 关节数 baseline 反而更强(-0.1321)、相机对(视角差)解释方差 eta²0.062 比 SMPL cov 0.018 还大、cov3d(3D自遮挡)没明显强于 cov2d → 隐藏变量是'遮挡越重越难'(occlusion-count)不是'共同可见表面', SMPL 几何=VPM/QPM/occlusion-count 换名无独特信号。
reassess/r_3.md:7343:./reassess/r_1.md:18:**残酷 meta-pattern**: 团队'独有资产'SMPL/人体几何**反复 reduce to 廉价代理**——exp333 SMPL-β≈random、pose 融 CLIP 五角度全死、SMPL-anchor VI-ReID 死、GOPL cov≈occlusion-count+view-diff。**SMPL 对 ReID 没有超出 occlusion-count/视角的独特判别信号。** 团队三大资产全弱: ①SMPL/几何(反复证伪) ②遮挡 ReID(历史5死角+三堵墙 completion/occluder-gate/visibility, exp109 oracle headroom 是 identity-conditioned 不可实现的墙) ③航拍-地面(ViSA/GSAlign/SeCap/DTST 占满+转 video/challenge)。**真的硬资产只有强 Swin/SOLIDER backbone**(occluded_duke 73.2 / CARGO 67.3)但那是 backbone 非方法。可用数据: occluded_duke / market / MSMT17 / CARGO / AG-ReID.v2 / occluded_reid。
reassess/r_3.md:7344:./reassess/r_2.md:16:- **死2(刚)**: GOPL'正样本关系粒度错了'(用 SMPL 共同可见人体表面 overlap 当 same-ID 正边可靠性)。冻结最强 occluded_duke ckpt(exp255, sanity mAP73.05≈训练73.2)测: cosine 距离确实弱负相关 overlap(rho≈-0.13)但: D5 随机关节子集打平(-0.1294≈真-0.1273)、cov2d 控住可见关节数后归零(+0.0145)、#vis 关节数 baseline 反而更强(-0.1321)、相机对(视角差)解释方差 eta²0.062 比 SMPL cov 0.018 还大、cov3d(3D自遮挡)没明显强于 cov2d → 隐藏变量是'遮挡越重越难'(occlusion-count)不是'共同可见表面', SMPL 几何=VPM/QPM/occlusion-count 换名无独特信号。
reassess/r_3.md:7345:./reassess/r_2.md:18:**残酷 meta-pattern**: 团队'独有资产'SMPL/人体几何**反复 reduce to 廉价代理**——exp333 SMPL-β≈random、pose 融 CLIP 五角度全死、SMPL-anchor VI-ReID 死、GOPL cov≈occlusion-count+view-diff。**SMPL 对 ReID 没有超出 occlusion-count/视角的独特判别信号。** 团队三大资产全弱: ①SMPL/几何(反复证伪) ②遮挡 ReID(历史5死角+三堵墙 completion/occluder-gate/visibility, exp109 oracle headroom 是 identity-conditioned 不可实现的墙) ③航拍-地面(ViSA/GSAlign/SeCap/DTST 占满+转 video/challenge)。**真的硬资产只有强 Swin/SOLIDER backbone**(occluded_duke 73.2 / CARGO 67.3)但那是 backbone 非方法。可用数据: occluded_duke / market / MSMT17 / CARGO / AG-ReID.v2 / occluded_reid。
reassess/r_3.md:7347:./validate/clean/v_2.txt:16:- vs **probabilistic embedding / uncertainty ReID**：PCME 用概率分布处理图文一对多对应，DUL/ReID uncertainty 用后验/先验高斯建模样本不确定性；它们不是 cross-view 物理方向的包含关系。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2101.05068?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2007.08785))
reassess/r_3.md:7348:./validate/clean/v_2.txt:17:- vs **OT-ReID / CM-EMD**：CM-EMD 是用最优传输做跨模态分布对齐，核心是 transport cost 和 intra-identity variation weighting；B 不能写成“更好的 OT”，而要强调**不求对齐/搬运，而是接受航拍证据欠定，用非对称覆盖打分**。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2203.01675?utm_source=openai))
reassess/r_3.md:7350:./validate/clean/v_2.txt:19:- vs **cross-resolution ReID**：PS-HRNet/RFD 这类线主要做恢复、变换或 resolution-invariant feature；B 的说法应是“不幻想补齐不可见细节，而是显式表达候选身份范围”。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2105.11722?utm_source=openai))
reassess/r_3.md:7352:./validate/clean/v_1.txt:30:Cross-resolution ReID 多数走 SR、resolution-invariant feature、pseudo-siamese 或多分辨率融合，不是“低分辨率 query 作为宽 identity posterior”。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2105.11722?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1908.06052?utm_source=openai))

reassess/r_3.md:7430:./validate/v_2.md:5109:./reviews/deep_25.md:14097:2. **重定义动作**：他们没有把问题讲成“遮挡区域检测不准”，而是拆成“pose misalignment under extreme occlusion”和“identity confusion caused by non-target pedestrian occlusion”。关键词是 pose-patch mapping、texture-aware decoder、non-target pedestrian occlusion、structure and detail dual constraints。这个拆解让方法天然有两个核心动作：结构上精确映射，细节上用纹理区分目标。

reassess/r_3.md:7474:./validate/v_2.md:7013:validate/v_3.md:1723:../codex_review_raw.txt:4434:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:54:"transfer_to_occluded": "The noise-masking attribute alignment loss: because attribute pseudo-labels encode the collective/majority attribute semantics of an identity, an occluded image's predicted attribute token at an occluded body region will mismatch the identity-level pseudo-label. AG-ReID masks out per-attribute alignment pairs whose cosine similarity falls below a threshold (set automatically per-dataset via Otsu's method to maximize inter-class variance), so the loss is computed only on reliable (visible) attribute matches and noisy occluded ones are dropped. This is a concrete, annotation-free, self-supervised way to detect-and-discard occluded/corrupted local features during training using consistency against an identity-level prototype, and the Otsu auto-thresholding removes manual per-dataset tuning — directly applicable to suppressing occluder-corrupted part features in any part/attribute-based occluded ReID model.",
reassess/r_3.md:7475:./validate/v_2.md:7014:validate/v_3.md:1761:../codex_review_raw.txt:4966:./experiments/transfer_candidates.json:54:"transfer_to_occluded": "The noise-masking attribute alignment loss: because attribute pseudo-labels encode the collective/majority attribute semantics of an identity, an occluded image's predicted attribute token at an occluded body region will mismatch the identity-level pseudo-label. AG-ReID masks out per-attribute alignment pairs whose cosine similarity falls below a threshold (set automatically per-dataset via Otsu's method to maximize inter-class variance), so the loss is computed only on reliable (visible) attribute matches and noisy occluded ones are dropped. This is a concrete, annotation-free, self-supervised way to detect-and-discard occluded/corrupted local features during training using consistency against an identity-level prototype, and the Otsu auto-thresholding removes manual per-dataset tuning — directly applicable to suppressing occluder-corrupted part features in any part/attribute-based occluded ReID model.",

reassess/r_3.md:7564:./validate/v_2.md:12327:- **#2 OVP-Mem 训练完成: 🎯 final 50.11 mAP(R1 54.93)@ep60, baseline 32.48 → +17.6, 达 VDT SOTA~50!** 轨迹 28.35→36.32→39.18→43.83→48.76→50.11。在 resnet50 BoT(弱于 VDT 的 ViT)上做到 SOTA 量级。★**方向铁证金矿**(代码双审无泄漏: 原型训练期/eval 测试 pid 不相交; +17.6 达 SOTA 待用户多 seed 复核)。但 OVP 撞 CMPC → **headline 走 OVLI**(见下), OVP 降为强 ablation。

reassess/r_3.md:7721:./reassess/r_3.md:16:- **死2(刚)**: GOPL'正样本关系粒度错了'(用 SMPL 共同可见人体表面 overlap 当 same-ID 正边可靠性)。冻结最强 occluded_duke ckpt(exp255, sanity mAP73.05≈训练73.2)测: cosine 距离确实弱负相关 overlap(rho≈-0.13)但: D5 随机关节子集打平(-0.1294≈真-0.1273)、cov2d 控住可见关节数后归零(+0.0145)、#vis 关节数 baseline 反而更强(-0.1321)、相机对(视角差)解释方差 eta²0.062 比 SMPL cov 0.018 还大、cov3d(3D自遮挡)没明显强于 cov2d → 隐藏变量是'遮挡越重越难'(occlusion-count)不是'共同可见表面', SMPL 几何=VPM/QPM/occlusion-count 换名无独特信号。
reassess/r_3.md:7722:./reassess/r_3.md:18:**残酷 meta-pattern**: 团队'独有资产'SMPL/人体几何**反复 reduce to 廉价代理**——exp333 SMPL-β≈random、pose 融 CLIP 五角度全死、SMPL-anchor VI-ReID 死、GOPL cov≈occlusion-count+view-diff。**SMPL 对 ReID 没有超出 occlusion-count/视角的独特判别信号。** 团队三大资产全弱: ①SMPL/几何(反复证伪) ②遮挡 ReID(历史5死角+三堵墙 completion/occluder-gate/visibility, exp109 oracle headroom 是 identity-conditioned 不可实现的墙) ③航拍-地面(ViSA/GSAlign/SeCap/DTST 占满+转 video/challenge)。**真的硬资产只有强 Swin/SOLIDER backbone**(occluded_duke 73.2 / CARGO 67.3)但那是 backbone 非方法。可用数据: occluded_duke / market / MSMT17 / CARGO / AG-ReID.v2 / occluded_reid。
reassess/r_3.md:7723:./reassess/r_3.md:23:角色=**遮挡最后一搏**。p_3提的遮挡source-separation(occlusion=别人身份污染target embedding, donor-ID泄漏)值不值得测? 但必须面对历史'occluder-gate是墙'(exp109: 即使gate掉遮挡, headroom是identity-conditioned不可实现)。设计**最锋利最便宜的kill-switch, 且必须同时回答'压制donor-ID泄漏能不能真涨ReID'**(不只是证泄漏存在——泄漏存在但压了不涨=撞墙=没用)。联网查novelty(撞TTPM/non-target-pedestrian-occlusion那批没)。如果连这都救不动或必撞墙, 诚实说'遮挡这块彻底关'。
reassess/r_3.md:7730:./reassess/r_3.md:1785:主文档确认了一个关键背景：遮挡方向已有大量“补全、可见性、结构关系、masking、metric alignment”负结果，且 exp109 一类结论确实在说可实现的遮挡处理很容易退化成 identity-conditioned oracle 不可达。现在我会专门检索本地 GOPL、source-separation、occluder-gate 相关材料，再做外部 novelty 对照。
reassess/r_3.md:7731:./reassess/r_3.md:1936:/bin/zsh -lc 'rg -n "exp109|occluder|donor|source[-_ ]separation|GOPL|overlap|SMPL|identity-conditioned|oracle|leak|泄漏|污染|遮挡" /Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments /Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2' in /Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2

reassess/r_3.md:7768:./reassess/r_3.md:2215:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_3.md:2011:## ★★★ 最强收敛发现:同框"入侵身份泄漏"(co-present identity leakage)
reassess/r_3.md:7770:./reassess/r_3.md:2218:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_3.md:2015:Occluded-Duke 的遮挡**大比例是"另一个行人"而非物体**。全领域(167篇)把遮挡当"信息缺失→补全(completion/pose/part/CLIP)"。**真正失败不是缺信息, 而是 target embedding 被遮挡那个人的身份污染**——一个 distractor identity 泄漏进来。这是 source-separation 问题, 与全场"补全"范式正交。**没有一篇这么做。**
reassess/r_3.md:7775:./reassess/r_3.md:2223:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_3.md:2023:- **★廉价 kill-switch(一晚)**: 合成人遮挡上, 用强 baseline(Swin-Small)embedding 训入侵者-ID 探针。≈随机→强主干已抑制无泄漏可挖→kill; >>随机→有故事。
reassess/r_3.md:7776:./reassess/r_3.md:2224:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_3.md:2026:reid-paper 项目 D4 诊断**已确认 donor-leakage 人际混淆在强主干仍持续(≈3×物体干扰)**——kill-switch 其实已经过了。衍生"donor-leakage 反事实一致性"方法 6-7/10、待探针。**库读证明: 你这条自己的活口, 正好是整个领域的空白。**
reassess/r_3.md:7780:./reassess/r_3.md:2231:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_3.md:2045:**领域(167篇)+ 你自己的 D4 诊断 + 获胜配方 三方收敛到同一个角度: 同框入侵身份泄漏的 source-separation(非补全)。** 这是 reid-paper 项目最强活口, 也是全领域空白, 且自带打 wall-2 的对照 + 一晚的 kill-switch。下一步: 核对"主要人物归属"当年判死理由 → 不撞则跑探针 → 建 donor-leakage 反事实一致性方法。
reassess/r_3.md:7781:./reassess/r_3.md:2237:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_3.md:2120:3. **SMPL 数据/提取=症结**：单图低分辨率遮挡 crop 上 ROMP 的 10-d 体型 β 被相机/姿态噪声主导、与细粒度身份无关 + 主动稀释外观。
reassess/r_3.md:7783:./reassess/r_3.md:2242:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_3.md:2183:- 遮挡方向不能再讲“缺失补全”，要重定义为：遮挡不是少信息，而是**别人的身份信息污染 target embedding**。
reassess/r_3.md:7784:./reassess/r_3.md:2243:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_3.md:2184:- 这能自然长出方法：训练期合成已知 donor identity 的人遮挡、压制 donor-ID 可预测性、保持 target identity 一致；推理期不加任何外部输入。
reassess/r_3.md:7785:./reassess/r_3.md:2244:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_3.md:2185:- 关键 kill-switch 很硬：冻结强 Swin embedding，训练 probe 预测遮挡者 / donor ID。若 probe 显著高于随机，且在人遮挡 split 高、物体遮挡/Market 低，这就是 B 类方法稿需要的隐藏变量。

reassess/r_3.md:7796:./reassess/r_3.md:2296:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_16.md:7635:2. 重定义动作：他们把遮挡从“需要鲁棒特征”改写成“特征空间里的结构化污染，需要反变换恢复干净身份表征”。关键词是 feature-level inpainting、inverse transform、clean identity-preserving embedding、de-occlusion、centroid-guided pruning。
reassess/r_3.md:7797:./reassess/r_3.md:2297:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_16.md:7636:3. 机制怎么长出来：如果接受“遮挡是特征污染”，扩散式去噪补全就很自然。DDO 用冻结 ViT 的干净特征作监督，把遮挡特征恢复成干净特征。HRR 则利用身份中心先筛候选，再做局部重排序。不过 HRR 依赖闭集身份结构，协议风险比 DDO 大。
reassess/r_3.md:7798:./reassess/r_3.md:2298:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_16.md:7637:4. 证据闭环：证据比较直接。可视化显示 DDO 把注意力从白墙、遮挡物拉回衣服、脸和可见身体；MSE、余弦误差和 SSIM 显示补全后特征更接近干净特征；DDO 插到 TransReID 和 Pass-ViT 也有增益。HRR 的证据更复杂，Occluded-Duke 上 mAP 从 81.8 到 90.6，但 Occluded-ReID 上会从 92.3 降到 90.1，作者也承认图库身份样本少或重遮挡时中心会偏。
reassess/r_3.md:7799:./reassess/r_3.md:2308:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_16.md:7688:2. 重定义动作：他们把遮挡从“需要鲁棒特征”改写成“特征空间里的结构化污染，需要反变换恢复干净身份表征”。关键词是 feature-level inpainting、inverse transform、clean identity-preserving embedding、de-occlusion、centroid-guided pruning。

reassess/r_3.md:7810:./reassess/r_3.md:2359:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp330_compositional_dro/design.md:9:ReID 模型在见过的遮挡组合上学到的是**occluder-specific 捷径**（"car 长这样→忽略"），而非**遮挡-不变的 part-identity 证据**。因此对**未见过的 (occluder类×部位) 组合**会崩。**group-DRO**（最小化 worst-group loss over occluder×part cells，而非平均 loss）逼模型学组合-不变的证据 → 在 held-out 组合上 > ERM。
reassess/r_3.md:7833:./reassess/r_3.md:2499:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_24.md:976:- **留给用户的提交前清单(全是战略决策或需谨慎实现的方法学变体,不擅自做)**：①拆通用vs遮挡贡献框架(战略) ②代价进主叙述(数据已备,placement战略) ③降级强说法(正交容量律→经验观察、selective"提升"→行为指标,战略=是否让步一个卖点) ④~~四组覆盖表~~已补 ⑤identity-block/每身份一 query 稳健性附录(高价值,直接消除最大理论攻击=簇内相关破坏可交换性;但属方法学变体,改 calibration 采样逻辑,按纪律新变体须先复现已知基线再下结论,留用户确认实现方式后再做,别在深夜赶) ⑥选会议(PRCV 0.52-0.66 最稳)/英文化/格式/投稿。

reassess/r_3.md:7863:./reassess/r_3.md:2858:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:855:./analyses/deep_16.txt:32:4. 证据闭环：证据比较直接。可视化显示 DDO 把注意力从白墙、遮挡物拉回衣服、脸和可见身体；MSE、余弦误差和 SSIM 显示补全后特征更接近干净特征；DDO 插到 TransReID 和 Pass-ViT 也有增益。HRR 的证据更复杂，Occluded-Duke 上 mAP 从 81.8 到 90.6，但 Occluded-ReID 上会从 92.3 降到 90.1，作者也承认图库身份样本少或重遮挡时中心会偏。

reassess/r_3.md:7872:./reassess/r_3.md:3040:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:2269:./validate/v_2.md:7013:validate/v_3.md:1723:../codex_review_raw.txt:4434:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:54:"transfer_to_occluded": "The noise-masking attribute alignment loss: because attribute pseudo-labels encode the collective/majority attribute semantics of an identity, an occluded image's predicted attribute token at an occluded body region will mismatch the identity-level pseudo-label. AG-ReID masks out per-attribute alignment pairs whose cosine similarity falls below a threshold (set automatically per-dataset via Otsu's method to maximize inter-class variance), so the loss is computed only on reliable (visible) attribute matches and noisy occluded ones are dropped. This is a concrete, annotation-free, self-supervised way to detect-and-discard occluded/corrupted local features during training using consistency against an identity-level prototype, and the Otsu auto-thresholding removes manual per-dataset tuning — directly applicable to suppressing occluder-corrupted part features in any part/attribute-based occluded ReID model.",
reassess/r_3.md:7873:./reassess/r_3.md:3041:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:2270:./validate/v_2.md:7014:validate/v_3.md:1761:../codex_review_raw.txt:4966:./experiments/transfer_candidates.json:54:"transfer_to_occluded": "The noise-masking attribute alignment loss: because attribute pseudo-labels encode the collective/majority attribute semantics of an identity, an occluded image's predicted attribute token at an occluded body region will mismatch the identity-level pseudo-label. AG-ReID masks out per-attribute alignment pairs whose cosine similarity falls below a threshold (set automatically per-dataset via Otsu's method to maximize inter-class variance), so the loss is computed only on reliable (visible) attribute matches and noisy occluded ones are dropped. This is a concrete, annotation-free, self-supervised way to detect-and-discard occluded/corrupted local features during training using consistency against an identity-level prototype, and the Otsu auto-thresholding removes manual per-dataset tuning — directly applicable to suppressing occluder-corrupted part features in any part/attribute-based occluded ReID model.",

reassess/r_3.md:7887:./reassess/r_3.md:3294:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_1.md:16:- **死2(刚)**: GOPL'正样本关系粒度错了'(用 SMPL 共同可见人体表面 overlap 当 same-ID 正边可靠性)。冻结最强 occluded_duke ckpt(exp255, sanity mAP73.05≈训练73.2)测: cosine 距离确实弱负相关 overlap(rho≈-0.13)但: D5 随机关节子集打平(-0.1294≈真-0.1273)、cov2d 控住可见关节数后归零(+0.0145)、#vis 关节数 baseline 反而更强(-0.1321)、相机对(视角差)解释方差 eta²0.062 比 SMPL cov 0.018 还大、cov3d(3D自遮挡)没明显强于 cov2d → 隐藏变量是'遮挡越重越难'(occlusion-count)不是'共同可见表面', SMPL 几何=VPM/QPM/occlusion-count 换名无独特信号。
reassess/r_3.md:7888:./reassess/r_3.md:3295:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_1.md:18:**残酷 meta-pattern**: 团队'独有资产'SMPL/人体几何**反复 reduce to 廉价代理**——exp333 SMPL-β≈random、pose 融 CLIP 五角度全死、SMPL-anchor VI-ReID 死、GOPL cov≈occlusion-count+view-diff。**SMPL 对 ReID 没有超出 occlusion-count/视角的独特判别信号。** 团队三大资产全弱: ①SMPL/几何(反复证伪) ②遮挡 ReID(历史5死角+三堵墙 completion/occluder-gate/visibility, exp109 oracle headroom 是 identity-conditioned 不可实现的墙) ③航拍-地面(ViSA/GSAlign/SeCap/DTST 占满+转 video/challenge)。**真的硬资产只有强 Swin/SOLIDER backbone**(occluded_duke 73.2 / CARGO 67.3)但那是 backbone 非方法。可用数据: occluded_duke / market / MSMT17 / CARGO / AG-ReID.v2 / occluded_reid。

reassess/r_3.md:7897:./reassess/r_3.md:3334:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:23:角色=**遮挡最后一搏**。p_3提的遮挡source-separation(occlusion=别人身份污染target embedding, donor-ID泄漏)值不值得测? 但必须面对历史'occluder-gate是墙'(exp109: 即使gate掉遮挡, headroom是identity-conditioned不可实现)。设计**最锋利最便宜的kill-switch, 且必须同时回答'压制donor-ID泄漏能不能真涨ReID'**(不只是证泄漏存在——泄漏存在但压了不涨=撞墙=没用)。联网查novelty(撞TTPM/non-target-pedestrian-occlusion那批没)。如果连这都救不动或必撞墙, 诚实说'遮挡这块彻底关'。
reassess/r_3.md:7901:./reassess/r_3.md:3351:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:1785:主文档确认了一个关键背景：遮挡方向已有大量“补全、可见性、结构关系、masking、metric alignment”负结果，且 exp109 一类结论确实在说可实现的遮挡处理很容易退化成 identity-conditioned oracle 不可达。现在我会专门检索本地 GOPL、source-separation、occluder-gate 相关材料，再做外部 novelty 对照。
reassess/r_3.md:7906:./reassess/r_3.md:3404:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/new_angle_AIRL.md:169:2. **头分化**: consistency 只读 f_rec(logits_rec/bn_feat_rec), f_full BNNeck/classifier 零 consistency **梯度**(smoke D4); clean f_rec 侧 detach(稳定目标)。**已知并接受的次要项(codex round-2 Medium)**: 退化 forward 是整模型 `model(deg_imgs)`(无 rec-only 路径), 故 f_full 的 frozen-bias BNNeck running mean/var 仍会"看到"退化 ground 图(仅统计跟踪, 非梯度泄漏)——与 `--airl` 单头路径完全一致(同一 degrade+forward 原语), 刻意保持对齐以保证消融诚实; 是否有实质影响由 kill-switch #4 训练结果裁决, 非 bug。若要彻底隔离需加 rec-only forward(改训练行为, 当前 lab-3090 正在跑此代码, 不动)。

reassess/r_3.md:7909:./reassess/r_3.md:3426:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_14.md:2780:创新类型是新数据设定加新机制。它定义 occluded VI-ReID，指出遮挡和跨模态会叠加造成空间错位和模态退化，并构造 Occluded-SYSU、Occluded-RegDB。能发靠新设定和补全机制双支撑。story 是：遮挡 ReID 不应只看可见区域，而要利用单模态上下文和跨模态互补信息补全缺失身份线索。

reassess/r_3.md:7966:./reassess/r_3.md:4148:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/codex_1.md:12144:../codex_review_raw.txt:4434:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:54:"transfer_to_occluded": "The noise-masking attribute alignment loss: because attribute pseudo-labels encode the collective/majority attribute semantics of an identity, an occluded image's predicted attribute token at an occluded body region will mismatch the identity-level pseudo-label. AG-ReID masks out per-attribute alignment pairs whose cosine similarity falls below a threshold (set automatically per-dataset via Otsu's method to maximize inter-class variance), so the loss is computed only on reliable (visible) attribute matches and noisy occluded ones are dropped. This is a concrete, annotation-free, self-supervised way to detect-and-discard occluded/corrupted local features during training using consistency against an identity-level prototype, and the Otsu auto-thresholding removes manual per-dataset tuning — directly applicable to suppressing occluder-corrupted part features in any part/attribute-based occluded ReID model.",

reassess/r_3.md:7995:./reassess/r_3.md:4483:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:22:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas for occluded ReID. (1) The pose loss L_p that explicitly minimizes cosine similarity between body-part features and non-human/background features — a cheap regularizer to suppress occluder/background leakage into the identity embedding, applicable to any pose- or part-based occluded model. (2) The texture-distinctiveness decoder channel aimed specifically at non-target PEDESTRIAN occlusion: when the occluder is itself a person, pose/structure cues fail (same skeleton topology), so using texture appearance distinctiveness (via pose-filtered queries cross-attending to contextual features) to push apart target vs distractor-person is a concrete mechanism for the under-addressed person-on-person occlusion case. Also transferable: replacing coarse pose-to-global mapping with a per-keypoint-to-patch confidence-gated argmax correspondence (Mahalanobis+cosine affine similarity) to localize visible regions.",
reassess/r_3.md:7997:./reassess/r_3.md:4485:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:37:"mechanism": "CSSA learns pixel-level part labels without any external pose/parsing model: it separates foreground from background by the heuristic that foreground feature maps have stronger L2-norm response, clusters foreground pixels via k-means across a clip (Np=6 fixed clusters), and uses cluster IDs as pseudo-labels to iteratively train a pixel-wise part classifier producing Np+1 confidence maps (parts plus background/occlusion). A CARE module aggregates the whole clip into a denoised video-level embedding (encoder-decoder with an identity cross-entropy bottleneck) and uses its cross-pixel cosine similarity to each frame pixel as a weighted residual gate that amplifies pixels consistent with the dominant identity and suppresses clutter/occluders. SGFA then builds the global feature pair-wise: each semantic part's contribution to the aggregated global vector is weighted by the product of its query and gallery confidence scores, so a part counts only when reliable in both images.",
reassess/r_3.md:7998:./reassess/r_3.md:4486:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:39:"transfer_to_occluded": "Apply SGFA's pair-wise reliability product to occluded image ReID: when scoring a probe against each gallery candidate, weight each body part's contribution by the product of the part's visibility/confidence in the probe AND in that candidate (recomputed per pair), rather than a single self-visibility mask. This makes a region count only when it is uncorrupted on both sides — directly addressing the occluded-ReID failure where a part visible in the probe but occluded in the gallery still injects noise. The L2-norm-response foreground heuristic also offers a cheap occluder/background suppressor (occluders/background give weaker feature norm than the target body) usable to derive a soft visibility map without a parsing model.",
reassess/r_3.md:7999:./reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",
reassess/r_3.md:8000:./reassess/r_3.md:4488:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:46:"transfer_to_occluded": "This paper IS occluded ReID, so the ideas are native rather than cross-subfield, but two components are concretely reusable in a different occluded pipeline: (1) Categorical learnable queries that explicitly separate \"visible-attribute\" tokens (A*) from \"occluder\" tokens (O*) via cross-attention to patches — i.e., learning an explicit occluder-description token forces the model to model the distractor rather than ignore it, which could be added to a non-CLIP backbone (e.g., Swin/PSG) as an auxiliary \"occluder branch\" whose features are pushed apart from identity features. (2) The entropy-based dynamic fusion: weight each candidate feature stream (global vs. part vs. pose-gated) by the entropy of its own ID-prediction distribution, so low-confidence (heavily occluded) streams are automatically down-weighted at the feature-fusion stage — a drop-in, training-only reliability gate that needs no extra labels and could replace fixed weights in a multi-branch occluded model.",
reassess/r_3.md:8001:./reassess/r_3.md:4489:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:54:"transfer_to_occluded": "The noise-masking attribute alignment loss: because attribute pseudo-labels encode the collective/majority attribute semantics of an identity, an occluded image's predicted attribute token at an occluded body region will mismatch the identity-level pseudo-label. AG-ReID masks out per-attribute alignment pairs whose cosine similarity falls below a threshold (set automatically per-dataset via Otsu's method to maximize inter-class variance), so the loss is computed only on reliable (visible) attribute matches and noisy occluded ones are dropped. This is a concrete, annotation-free, self-supervised way to detect-and-discard occluded/corrupted local features during training using consistency against an identity-level prototype, and the Otsu auto-thresholding removes manual per-dataset tuning — directly applicable to suppressing occluder-corrupted part features in any part/attribute-based occluded ReID model.",
reassess/r_3.md:8002:./reassess/r_3.md:4490:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:78:"transfer_to_occluded": "Recast the occluder as a confounder and apply the same backdoor-adjustment recipe: build an \"Occluder Dictionary\" of occlusion patterns/regions stored as Gaussians with priors P(occluder), then train with P(Y|do(X))=Σ_occluder P(Y|X,occluder)·P(occluder), marginalizing over occluders so the model cannot exploit occluder-identity spurious correlations (e.g. a particular bicycle/car/pole co-occurring with certain galleries or cameras). Two concretely transferable tricks: (1) the reverse-attention masking that isolates the confounder feature from the identity feature map — directly usable to separate occluder-region features from body features without external segmentation; (2) representing each confounder as a sampled Gaussian rather than a stored feature, giving cheap synthetic occluder augmentation at the feature level. The NWGM trick keeps the marginalization a single classification, so it's nearly free at training time and zero-cost at inference.",
reassess/r_3.md:8008:./reassess/r_3.md:4496:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:119:"transfer_to_occluded": "Repurpose the mask-guided, pose-conditioned diffusion inpainting from \"swap the clothing region\" to \"fill the occluded region\": use a body-segmentation/visibility mask to mark missing or occluder-corrupted body parts, then inpaint them with OpenPose-keypoint-conditioned Stable Diffusion to synthesize plausible body content, generating occlusion-augmented training pairs (or recovered query images). Critically, transfer their two-stage quality gate — admit a recovered region only if its ReID-feature similarity to the clean identity is high and its FID is low — so hallucinated content is filtered before it pollutes training, addressing the chronic risk that completion/inpainting injects identity-inconsistent features in occluded ReID.",
reassess/r_3.md:8009:./reassess/r_3.md:4497:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:126:"transfer_to_occluded": "The Intersection-Alignment Score (IAS) explainable re-ranking is directly occlusion-relevant: compute IoU between the model's activation/attention map and a visible-region (non-occluded) mask, plus a cosine alignment between query and gallery activation maps, then refine the distance matrix — multiply distance by alpha<1 when attention focuses on visible regions AND query/gallery attentions agree, and by beta>1 when attention falls on occluded/missing regions. In occluded ReID this is a self-supervised matching-side trust mechanism: down-weight matches whose discriminative evidence sits on occluder/missing pixels and reward query-gallery pairs whose visible-region attention co-aligns, without needing identity-level supervision. The canonical-UV idea (mapping body regions to fixed coordinates so the same part always aligns) is also a clean way to make two partially-occluded crops compare only on their commonly-visible parts.",
reassess/r_3.md:8011:./reassess/r_3.md:4501:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:150:"transfer_to_occluded": "This paper IS occluded ReID, so the whole pipeline is on-domain, but the single most transferable trick is treating occlusion as an explicitly invertible map T in FEATURE space and learning T^-1 with paired clean/occluded-feature supervision — instead of masking/suppressing occluded regions, you generatively reconstruct the clean identity embedding before it reaches the ReID head. Concretely transferable pieces: (1) train a feature-space de-occluder on synthetic occlusion pairs (silhouette-guided background patching + Fourier-domain adaptation to bridge synth-to-real) where the FROZEN ViT clean feature is the ground truth, so no occlusion masks are needed at test time; (2) keep both reconstructed and raw occluded features and fuse them with cross-attention (Q=clean, K/V=occluded) rather than discarding the occluded one — the reconstruction acts as a query that re-attends the raw features toward visible identity regions, which is robust when reconstruction is imperfect; (3) the reconstruction-loss-as-classifier-guidance idea turns an unconditional generative module into an identity-preserving deterministic operator, directly useful for any completion-based occluded-ReID module to avoid hallucinating wrong identities.",
reassess/r_3.md:8012:./reassess/r_3.md:4502:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:151:"novel_component": "Formulating occlusion as a deterministic, invertible transform T in deep-feature space and learning its inverse T^-1 via a latent diffusion model supervised by paired clean ViT features — i.e. feature-space inpainting where a reconstruction loss plays the role of classifier guidance, yielding a deterministic identity-preserving de-occluder rather than a stochastic sampler, and crucially requiring no masks/pose/parsing at inference.",
reassess/r_3.md:8014:./reassess/r_3.md:4505:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:182:"transfer_to_occluded": "Adopt the dense pixel-to-3D-vertex correspondence embedding as an occlusion-aware matching substrate: train a per-pixel head that maps each foreground pixel to a canonical SMPL-vertex embedding (supervised by geodesic/tangent-consistent vertex codes). Then (a) occluded/missing body regions are explicitly detected as 3D vertices with no supporting pixel, yielding a per-vertex visibility/support map for free, and (b) two images are matched only over their shared visible 3D vertices (\"common visible support\"), making the comparison occlusion-robust without relying on holistic features. The cross-frame \"same-vertex => consistent embedding\" constraint also provides a structural prior to inpaint or down-weight corrupted regions.",
reassess/r_3.md:8018:./reassess/r_3.md:4587:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp047/monitor.md:363:3. 遮挡模式由相机角度和场景布局决定，与身份无关

reassess/r_3.md:8032:./reassess/r_3.md:4760:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:420:1. ⭐ **因果 backdoor-triplet**(搬 gait GaitC3I TIP25/GaitSCM CVIU24)：把 camera-id+occlusion-state 当显式混淆变量 C, backdoor adjustment 改 triplet 正样本采样, 让跨遮挡/跨摄像头正样本对不再发协变量差异冒充身份的有害梯度。仓库零因果/SCM 代码(唯一命中 DACHM/DACCM 是 training-free reranker, 另一 lever)。**唯一同时满足: 问题重定义+机制新+零代码+避所有已死框架**。遮挡状态从 pose 可见性直接得。0.5天无训练首验。
reassess/r_3.md:8035:./reassess/r_3.md:4771:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:476:- 范式调研同时**否证一批**: gait occlusion-type/residual=已关; CC-ReID 因果换衣=无遮挡 analog 不撞 disentangle; vehicle VANet 两度量=common-support 已死; set/video quality-pool=visibility 已关。诚实负面收窄空间。
reassess/r_3.md:8036:./reassess/r_3.md:4772:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:480:- **✅ 前提 HOLDS**: query(遮挡) intra-token self-sim **0.4459** vs gallery(整体) **0.4253** = **+0.0206**(occluded 更 bursty)。即便强通用 DINO 特征上, 遮挡图也确实有更多冗余/过表达 token(occluder/背景泄漏区天然高自相似)——正是机制要降权的对象。**机制有燃料。**
reassess/r_3.md:8038:./reassess/r_3.md:4780:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:511:- **设计**: 3 occluder类(car/bicycle/person, VOC2012 分割patch)× 3 部位(head/torso/legs=上/中/下三分区, region-based 免pose)=9 cells; 训练见 6, hold out 3 对角(car-legs/bicycle-torso/person-head); ERM(mean CE) vs online group-DRO(7组=6cell+clean, present-group 重归一保 CE 尺度=单变量)。eval=Market 整体 query 施 cell 合成遮挡(按(cell,image)确定性seed, ERM/DRO 同遮挡), clean gallery, per-cell mAP。
reassess/r_3.md:8046:./reassess/r_3.md:4915:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/paper_notes/paper_21_20260322_direction_reset.md:109:**一句话**: 用姿态热图生成两张“互补可见”的伪视图，不再做随机遮挡，而是训练模型从互补 body support 中学习稳定身份表示。
reassess/r_3.md:8051:./reassess/r_3.md:5139:本地 exp109 的原始记录比当前叙述更细：oracle support bank 上界是强阳性，但它用 GT same-ID prototype，是“知道目标身份以后怎么补”的上界；这正是 donor-source-separation 必须绕开的墙。真正的 kill-switch 不能只测“泄漏能不能被检测”，必须在 frozen 特征上直接测“无 GT 身份、只按遮挡源压制后，排序是否上升”。
reassess/r_3.md:8052:./reassess/r_3.md:5146:> 大家以为跨视角/遮挡 ReID 难在"特征对齐不够"，其实是 **正样本关系粒度错了**：ReID 训练把同一 ID 的所有 pair 当**等价**正样本强拉近，但两张图**共同可观测的人体表面**可能几乎不重叠（一张遮腿一张遮躯干→共同只剩头），此时"同一身份"是**过强监督**，会把不可对齐的远程正边硬拉，污染 identity manifold。

reassess/r_3.md:8057:./pivot/p_2.md:700:./validate/clean/v_2.txt:16:- vs **probabilistic embedding / uncertainty ReID**：PCME 用概率分布处理图文一对多对应，DUL/ReID uncertainty 用后验/先验高斯建模样本不确定性；它们不是 cross-view 物理方向的包含关系。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2101.05068?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2007.08785))
reassess/r_3.md:8059:./pivot/p_2.md:702:./validate/clean/v_2.txt:19:- vs **cross-resolution ReID**：PS-HRNet/RFD 这类线主要做恢复、变换或 resolution-invariant feature；B 的说法应是“不幻想补齐不可见细节，而是显式表达候选身份范围”。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2105.11722?utm_source=openai))
reassess/r_3.md:8063:./pivot/p_2.md:855:./analyses/deep_16.txt:32:4. 证据闭环：证据比较直接。可视化显示 DDO 把注意力从白墙、遮挡物拉回衣服、脸和可见身体；MSE、余弦误差和 SSIM 显示补全后特征更接近干净特征；DDO 插到 TransReID 和 Pass-ViT 也有增益。HRR 的证据更复杂，Occluded-Duke 上 mAP 从 81.8 到 90.6，但 Occluded-ReID 上会从 92.3 降到 90.1，作者也承认图库身份样本少或重遮挡时中心会偏。

reassess/r_3.md:8090:./pivot/p_2.md:2269:./validate/v_2.md:7013:validate/v_3.md:1723:../codex_review_raw.txt:4434:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:54:"transfer_to_occluded": "The noise-masking attribute alignment loss: because attribute pseudo-labels encode the collective/majority attribute semantics of an identity, an occluded image's predicted attribute token at an occluded body region will mismatch the identity-level pseudo-label. AG-ReID masks out per-attribute alignment pairs whose cosine similarity falls below a threshold (set automatically per-dataset via Otsu's method to maximize inter-class variance), so the loss is computed only on reliable (visible) attribute matches and noisy occluded ones are dropped. This is a concrete, annotation-free, self-supervised way to detect-and-discard occluded/corrupted local features during training using consistency against an identity-level prototype, and the Otsu auto-thresholding removes manual per-dataset tuning — directly applicable to suppressing occluder-corrupted part features in any part/attribute-based occluded ReID model.",
reassess/r_3.md:8091:./pivot/p_2.md:2270:./validate/v_2.md:7014:validate/v_3.md:1761:../codex_review_raw.txt:4966:./experiments/transfer_candidates.json:54:"transfer_to_occluded": "The noise-masking attribute alignment loss: because attribute pseudo-labels encode the collective/majority attribute semantics of an identity, an occluded image's predicted attribute token at an occluded body region will mismatch the identity-level pseudo-label. AG-ReID masks out per-attribute alignment pairs whose cosine similarity falls below a threshold (set automatically per-dataset via Otsu's method to maximize inter-class variance), so the loss is computed only on reliable (visible) attribute matches and noisy occluded ones are dropped. This is a concrete, annotation-free, self-supervised way to detect-and-discard occluded/corrupted local features during training using consistency against an identity-level prototype, and the Otsu auto-thresholding removes manual per-dataset tuning — directly applicable to suppressing occluder-corrupted part features in any part/attribute-based occluded ReID model.",

reassess/r_3.md:8114:./pivot/p_2.md:5140:pivot/p_3.md:2015:Occluded-Duke 的遮挡**大比例是"另一个行人"而非物体**。全领域(167篇)把遮挡当"信息缺失→补全(completion/pose/part/CLIP)"。**真正失败不是缺信息, 而是 target embedding 被遮挡那个人的身份污染**——一个 distractor identity 泄漏进来。这是 source-separation 问题, 与全场"补全"范式正交。**没有一篇这么做。**

reassess/r_3.md:8179:./pivot/p_2.md:6913:reviews/deep_25.md:14097:2. **重定义动作**：他们没有把问题讲成“遮挡区域检测不准”，而是拆成“pose misalignment under extreme occlusion”和“identity confusion caused by non-target pedestrian occlusion”。关键词是 pose-patch mapping、texture-aware decoder、non-target pedestrian occlusion、structure and detail dual constraints。这个拆解让方法天然有两个核心动作：结构上精确映射，细节上用纹理区分目标。

reassess/r_3.md:8431:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/decisions.md:4521:**红蓝队**：未单独跑（决策风险低、可逆、纯空闲 GPU、双审查已过）；先验 ~75% 偏负（Swin 占最判别方向、global-only 解相关不针对遮挡盲点、95.8% 全可见墙）已诚实记入 design.md 失败模式。
reassess/r_3.md:8438:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/decisions.md:4558:**判定(看量级)**: 前提**成立**——遮挡确是一条**巨大、可分离、遮挡特有、非采样伪影**的 domain 轴, 结构简单到对角高斯 KL 能量到、一个线性方向就近完美分开 → 符合"一个 normalization/对齐模块可吸收"的 VC-Norm 假设。GCN 已部分修复(post KL↓)但远未抹平 → VC-Norm 与 GCN 不重复、有 headroom。

reassess/r_3.md:8450:本地 GOPL kill-switch 设计已经明确把“2D 可见性解释同样强”列为致命红线；用户给出的新结果正好击中这条红线。遮挡 source-separation 只有一条很窄的生路：它必须把隐藏变量从“目标缺失多少”换成“遮挡者身份向量具体污染了谁”，并且压掉这部分后直接提高 ReID，而不是又回到 occlusion-count。
reassess/r_3.md:8467:一个做行人 ReID 的团队要发 CCF-B **方法稿**, 刚连续用零训练 kill-switch 干净杀掉两个方向:
reassess/r_3.md:8469:- **死2(刚)**: GOPL'正样本关系粒度错了'(用 SMPL 共同可见人体表面 overlap 当 same-ID 正边可靠性)。冻结最强 occluded_duke ckpt(exp255, sanity mAP73.05≈训练73.2)测: cosine 距离确实弱负相关 overlap(rho≈-0.13)但: D5 随机关节子集打平(-0.1294≈真-0.1273)、cov2d 控住可见关节数后归零(+0.0145)、#vis 关节数 baseline 反而更强(-0.1321)、相机对(视角差)解释方差 eta²0.062 比 SMPL cov 0.018 还大、cov3d(3D自遮挡)没明显强于 cov2d → 隐藏变量是'遮挡越重越难'(occlusion-count)不是'共同可见表面', SMPL 几何=VPM/QPM/occlusion-count 换名无独特信号。
reassess/r_3.md:8471:**残酷 meta-pattern**: 团队'独有资产'SMPL/人体几何**反复 reduce to 廉价代理**——exp333 SMPL-β≈random、pose 融 CLIP 五角度全死、SMPL-anchor VI-ReID 死、GOPL cov≈occlusion-count+view-diff。**SMPL 对 ReID 没有超出 occlusion-count/视角的独特判别信号。** 团队三大资产全弱: ①SMPL/几何(反复证伪) ②遮挡 ReID(历史5死角+三堵墙 completion/occluder-gate/visibility, exp109 oracle headroom 是 identity-conditioned 不可实现的墙) ③航拍-地面(ViSA/GSAlign/SeCap/DTST 占满+转 video/challenge)。**真的硬资产只有强 Swin/SOLIDER backbone**(occluded_duke 73.2 / CARGO 67.3)但那是 backbone 非方法。可用数据: occluded_duke / market / MSMT17 / CARGO / AG-ReID.v2 / occluded_reid。
reassess/r_3.md:8476:角色=**遮挡最后一搏**。p_3提的遮挡source-separation(occlusion=别人身份污染target embedding, donor-ID泄漏)值不值得测? 但必须面对历史'occluder-gate是墙'(exp109: 即使gate掉遮挡, headroom是identity-conditioned不可实现)。设计**最锋利最便宜的kill-switch, 且必须同时回答'压制donor-ID泄漏能不能真涨ReID'**(不只是证泄漏存在——泄漏存在但压了不涨=撞墙=没用)。联网查novelty(撞TTPM/non-target-pedestrian-occlusion那批没)。如果连这都救不动或必撞墙, 诚实说'遮挡这块彻底关'。
reassess/r_3.md:8696:4. **证据闭环**：组件消融直接对应两个重定义。CUHK-PEDES baseline 是 70.79 rank-1、64.69 mAP；SRDA 到 74.35、69.63；CSRM 到 72.02、68.13；完整 PSSR 到 75.71、73.34。ICFG-PEDES 从 61.30、37.68 到 65.91、48.11，RSTPReid 从 59.20、46.65 到 62.53、51.77。传统 re-ranking 在 CUHK 上 rank-1 反而从 74.35 降到 68.68，而 CSRM 到 75.71，这很好地证明“同模态 re-ranking 假设不适用于跨模态”。高伪影样本也能涨点，低伪影和高伪影一起最好，支撑“视觉真实不是核心，多样性才是核心”。
reassess/r_3.md:8704:2. **重定义动作**：他们没有把问题讲成“遮挡区域检测不准”，而是拆成“pose misalignment under extreme occlusion”和“identity confusion caused by non-target pedestrian occlusion”。关键词是 pose-patch mapping、texture-aware decoder、non-target pedestrian occlusion、structure and detail dual constraints。这个拆解让方法天然有两个核心动作：结构上精确映射，细节上用纹理区分目标。
reassess/r_3.md:8731:analyses/deep_15.txt:19:2. **重定义动作**：它把问题从“学习衣服无关特征”改成“在衣服相关区域中解耦身份相关信息”。关键词是 `identity-aware feature decoupling`、`ID-based knowledge transfer`、`clothing bias diminishing`、`clothing contrastive loss`。大家以为衣服区域要被抑制，其实衣服区域里还藏着体型、轮廓等身份线索，关键是别让颜色纹理主导。
reassess/r_3.md:8742:analyses/deep_7.txt:31:2. 重定义动作：大家以为换衣 ReID 需要“去衣服”或借助外部模态，作者改说：不需要额外模态，RGB 特征里已经有 identity-related content semantics 和 identity-related salient semantics，只是过去没有把两者分开挖掘和协同。关键词是 content semantics、salient semantics、abundant semantics、without auxiliaries。
reassess/r_3.md:8747:analyses/deep_7.txt:59:4. 证据闭环：Fig.1 的 corruption t-SNE 是重定义的根证据。四种协议 Clean Eval、Corrupt Eval、Corrupt Query、Corrupt Gallery 证明作者没有只测一种有利场景。Market-1501 的 Corrupt Eval 相对 baseline 有大幅提升，mINP 从 18.48 到 32.96，mAP 从 56.36 到 69.74，Rank-1 从 75.86 到 85.68。Clean Eval 略降反而支撑了作者说法：对齐会牺牲部分干净域特定信息，但换来 corruption-invariant 表征。
reassess/r_3.md:8757:analyses/deep_23.txt:20:3. **机制怎么长出来**：SSE 用两个 prompt，一个描述 person，一个描述 clothes。先得到身份文本特征和衣服文本特征，再把衣服方向从身份方向里投影并减掉，得到去衣服后的语义特征。SIM 再让这个正交化文本特征通过非局部操作和跨注意力去指导视觉特征。这个设计和“负语义分离、正语义引导”的重定义绑定很紧。
reassess/r_3.md:8758:analyses/deep_23.txt:21:4. **证据闭环**：它的关键消融是 SSE 单独有效，SIM 单独在 CNN 上甚至会伤性能，SSE 加 SIM 才最好。这证明“文本指导本身不够，必须先把衣服语义分离干净”。t-SNE 更紧凑、prompt 引导热图更关注头肩、下身、鞋，特征相似度分布在正交化后更清晰，这些可视化都在支撑“语义分离是对的”。
reassess/r_3.md:8776:analyses/deep_4.txt:69:3. 机制怎么长出来：机制和重定义绑定非常紧。既然衣服 C 是 confounder，就要建 Confounder Dictionary，存每件衣服的分布和先验 P(c)。既然目标是 P(Y|do(X))，Intervention Module 就按 backdoor adjustment 对所有衣服条件求和，而不是只看当前图像衣服。既然 intervention 依赖“衣服表示必须是衣服而不是身份”，就加 Disentangle Regularization，把 identity feature 和 clothing feature 拉开。这里不是先有模块再找故事，而是每个模块都能对应 causal graph 里的变量。
reassess/r_3.md:8792:analyses/deep_5.txt:56:5. 审稿人为什么买账：这篇卖的是视角加协议适配。它不是简单说“CLIP 用在 ReID”，而是把 CLIP 放进 ICS 的特殊标签结构里，用剩余标签解决缺失标签带来的跨相机偏差。对我们有用的套路是，先精确定义“哪些监督缺失，哪些监督还在”，然后让机制围绕剩余监督自然展开。
reassess/r_3.md:8795:analyses/deep_25.txt:33:3. **机制怎么长出来**：机制几乎是从重定义里长出来的。先在 SMPL mesh 上预训练 vertex embeddings，让嵌入距离对应 geodesic distance 和 tangent direction；再用 3D mesh recovery 和相机参数把顶点、采样表面点投影到 2D 图像，训练 U-Net 输出 pixel-level dense correspondence embeddings；视频帧串起来就是 3D gait field。然后用 local similarity learning 建模局部时空邻域，最后用 MRIE 的全局和局部代表 token 让 gait 和 appearance 高效交互。这里不是随便拼模块，主线是“稀疏 3D 先验变成稠密、时空对齐、可融合的 ReID 表示”。
reassess/r_3.md:8797:analyses/deep_25.txt:37:5. **reviewer 为什么买账**：这篇卖的是视角加表示范式。novelty 不在“用 gait”本身，而在“把 3D gait 从稀疏骨架或低维参数，重做成 2D 视频域稠密场”。这是比较像方法稿的创新构造：有明确旧表示缺陷，有自然机制，有替换模态消融和可视化支撑。缺点是工程重、依赖训练期 3D recovery，但作者通过推理期不需要 SMPL 来缓解这个风险。
reassess/r_3.md:8800:analyses/deep_25.txt:67:2. **重定义动作**：他们没有把问题讲成“遮挡区域检测不准”，而是拆成“pose misalignment under extreme occlusion”和“identity confusion caused by non-target pedestrian occlusion”。关键词是 pose-patch mapping、texture-aware decoder、non-target pedestrian occlusion、structure and detail dual constraints。这个拆解让方法天然有两个核心动作：结构上精确映射，细节上用纹理区分目标。
reassess/r_3.md:8807:analyses/deep_18.txt:46:2. **重定义动作**：它把“换衣 ReID 的核心是衣服偏差”改成“换衣 ReID 同时有 hairstyle shortcut 和 clothing structure loss”。关键词是 `hairstyle distraction`、`structural preservation`、`same-identity different-hairstyle`、`cloth-preserved random erasing`。
reassess/r_3.md:8820:analyses/deep_21.txt:59:4. **证据闭环**：最关键消融是 VARA、SAM、SMCF 分开加。VARA 证明中间层抑制有效，SAM 证明骨架区域比点热图更完整。进一步分析 VARA 插入位置，发现中层最好，这正好支撑“输出层太晚、低层语义不够、高层分辨率太低”的重定义。SAM 的 α、γ、T 可视化和不同遮挡程度可视化，也在证明骨架区域建模确实覆盖可见身体而抑制遮挡。
reassess/r_3.md:8825:analyses/deep_26.txt:23:4. 证据闭环：数据集 AT-USTC 本身证明旧数据集缺口，21 个月、RGB 和红外、多衣服、多季节支撑“anytime”成立。模型证据包括六场景分别评测、跨数据集泛化、MS-ReID、MoAE、HDW 消融，以及和其他 MoE 方法对比，证明不是单纯多头分类。
reassess/r_3.md:8844:analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:73:4. **证据闭环**：它用方法表、数据集表、参数量和 Rank-1 对比、benchmark/protocol 汇总、挑战清单和 3DGait 医疗任务 case study 来证明 SRID 不是零散技巧，而是有共同问题、共同评价和外溢应用的方向。
reassess/r_3.md:8856:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/decisions.md:4558:**判定(看量级)**: 前提**成立**——遮挡确是一条**巨大、可分离、遮挡特有、非采样伪影**的 domain 轴, 结构简单到对角高斯 KL 能量到、一个线性方向就近完美分开 → 符合"一个 normalization/对齐模块可吸收"的 VC-Norm 假设。GCN 已部分修复(post KL↓)但远未抹平 → VC-Norm 与 GCN 不重复、有 headroom。

reassess/r_3.md:11153:reviews/deep_28.md:374:阅读已完成：167 篇全覆盖。38 篇范围内精读 + 88 篇范围外粗读由 codex 完成（笔记 paper_notes/notes/in_*.md、out_*.md），剩 41 篇因 codex 额度耗尽（2026-06-11 13:01 恢复）由 Claude 摘要级补读（missing_41_skim_by_claude.md）。元分析和候选方向写在 **paper_notes/SYNTHESIS.md**，要点：(1) 在"单 embedding、测试无额外输入"口径下我们的 SOLIDER Swin-Small 纯基线 66.5 已处于已发表 B 类遮挡工作头部（发表水位 57.8-65.5，仅 arXiv 的 DPL-ReID 67.2 和测试期多部件距离的 AOANet 70.6 更高）；(2) 模块类增益=弱基线假象（这批论文内部基线 48-53 起步），反向验证我们 13 个判负；(3) 站得住的增益全部来自训练期新信息源（VLM 语义/外部遮挡物数据/生成数据/分布先验）；(4) 空白=遮挡结构化 VLM 语义当纯训练期监督蒸馏进非 CLIP 强人本主干、测试回纯单 embedding，没人做过。候选 A=该语义蒸馏方向（先零训练探针：冻结 SOLIDER 特征能否线性解码 CLIP 属性/遮挡物标签，解码不出的残差是否关联检索错误）；候选 B=真实遮挡物数据源+分布先验（最便宜，A 的对照轴）；候选 C=干净到遮挡的结构保持蒸馏（中风险排队）；候选 D=可靠检索稿保底投 PRCV。待办：codex 额度恢复后对候选 A 做独立新颖性红队，然后交用户挑方向。未开任何实验。
reassess/r_3.md:11155:analyses/deep_25.txt:67:2. **重定义动作**：他们没有把问题讲成“遮挡区域检测不准”，而是拆成“pose misalignment under extreme occlusion”和“identity confusion caused by non-target pedestrian occlusion”。关键词是 pose-patch mapping、texture-aware decoder、non-target pedestrian occlusion、structure and detail dual constraints。这个拆解让方法天然有两个核心动作：结构上精确映射，细节上用纹理区分目标。

reassess/r_3.md:11273:pivot/p_2.md:6913:reviews/deep_25.md:14097:2. **重定义动作**：他们没有把问题讲成“遮挡区域检测不准”，而是拆成“pose misalignment under extreme occlusion”和“identity confusion caused by non-target pedestrian occlusion”。关键词是 pose-patch mapping、texture-aware decoder、non-target pedestrian occlusion、structure and detail dual constraints。这个拆解让方法天然有两个核心动作：结构上精确映射，细节上用纹理区分目标。

reassess/r_3.md:11307:pivot/p_2.md:7972:analyses/deep_25.txt:67:2. **重定义动作**：他们没有把问题讲成“遮挡区域检测不准”，而是拆成“pose misalignment under extreme occlusion”和“identity confusion caused by non-target pedestrian occlusion”。关键词是 pose-patch mapping、texture-aware decoder、non-target pedestrian occlusion、structure and detail dual constraints。这个拆解让方法天然有两个核心动作：结构上精确映射，细节上用纹理区分目标。

一个做行人 ReID 的团队要发 CCF-B **方法稿**, 刚连续用零训练 kill-switch 干净杀掉两个方向:
- **死1**: 航拍-地面'物理定向不确定性包含'——前提 σ_aerial<σ_ground(航拍其实更平滑)就错, 包含'收益'是检索 artifact。
- **死2(刚)**: GOPL'正样本关系粒度错了'(用 SMPL 共同可见人体表面 overlap 当 same-ID 正边可靠性)。冻结最强 occluded_duke ckpt(exp255, sanity mAP73.05≈训练73.2)测: cosine 距离确实弱负相关 overlap(rho≈-0.13)但: D5 随机关节子集打平(-0.1294≈真-0.1273)、cov2d 控住可见关节数后归零(+0.0145)、#vis 关节数 baseline 反而更强(-0.1321)、相机对(视角差)解释方差 eta²0.062 比 SMPL cov 0.018 还大、cov3d(3D自遮挡)没明显强于 cov2d → 隐藏变量是'遮挡越重越难'(occlusion-count)不是'共同可见表面', SMPL 几何=VPM/QPM/occlusion-count 换名无独特信号。

**残酷 meta-pattern**: 团队'独有资产'SMPL/人体几何**反复 reduce to 廉价代理**——exp333 SMPL-β≈random、pose 融 CLIP 五角度全死、SMPL-anchor VI-ReID 死、GOPL cov≈occlusion-count+view-diff。**SMPL 对 ReID 没有超出 occlusion-count/视角的独特判别信号。** 团队三大资产全弱: ①SMPL/几何(反复证伪) ②遮挡 ReID(历史5死角+三堵墙 completion/occluder-gate/visibility, exp109 oracle headroom 是 identity-conditioned 不可实现的墙) ③航拍-地面(ViSA/GSAlign/SeCap/DTST 占满+转 video/challenge)。**真的硬资产只有强 Swin/SOLIDER backbone**(occluded_duke 73.2 / CARGO 67.3)但那是 backbone 非方法。可用数据: occluded_duke / market / MSMT17 / CARGO / AG-ReID.v2 / occluded_reid。

方法论(团队读167篇方法稿总结): B类创新=失败观察→重定义隐藏变量→机制自然长出→证重定义对。22招式(数学化/可测中间变量/对齐伤判别/因果/改信号角色/顺序错了/新协议/非对称包含/数据中心反直觉/旧法在新基座失效等)。

== 你的任务 ==
角色=**遮挡最后一搏**。p_3提的遮挡source-separation(occlusion=别人身份污染target embedding, donor-ID泄漏)值不值得测? 但必须面对历史'occluder-gate是墙'(exp109: 即使gate掉遮挡, headroom是identity-conditioned不可实现)。设计**最锋利最便宜的kill-switch, 且必须同时回答'压制donor-ID泄漏能不能真涨ReID'**(不只是证泄漏存在——泄漏存在但压了不涨=撞墙=没用)。联网查novelty(撞TTPM/non-target-pedestrian-occlusion那批没)。如果连这都救不动或必撞墙, 诚实说'遮挡这块彻底关'。

codex
结论：我只推荐 **1 个主线 + 1 个备胎**。不要再救 SMPL / 遮挡 / 航拍-地面；也不要把“相机偏差”当主线，DART³ 已经把 camera bias + distance-aware TTA 写得很近，CA-Jaccard 也占了 camera-aware neighbor/re-ranking 这块。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.18337)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.10605))

**方向 1，主推：Gallery Hubness ReID**
一句话：大家以为强 ReID 失败来自“某个 query 没匹配好”，其实可能是 **少数 gallery 样本变成很多 query 的吸附点**，错误是 many-to-one 的图库拓扑病，不是 pairwise 相似度病。

触发观察：
用 exp255 / 强 Swin 冻结特征，在 Market/MSMT/CARGO 标准检索上统计每个 gallery 被多少 query 放进 top-k。若 top 1% gallery 贡献了远超比例的 false top-10 / false top-1，这就是新观察。

重定义：
ReID 不是独立 query-gallery pair matching，而是 **directed kNN graph retrieval**。隐藏变量不是 hard negative distance，而是 gallery 的 **negative in-degree / hub mass**。这和普通 hard negative mining 不一样：hard negative 是“对一个 anchor 很近”，hub 是“对很多不同身份都很近”。旧 triplet/quadruplet 主要还是 per-anchor 或 batch 内 hard sample。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1704.01719))

机制怎么长：
训练端做 **Hub-Aware Retrieval Embedding**，不加花模块，只改训练组织：
- memory bank 维护每个样本的 cross-ID top-k in-degree；
- 对“吸引很多错误身份”的 gallery 施加 anti-hub margin；
- 正常 ID loss / triplet 保留，但 negative 权重从“离 anchor 多近”改为“它是否是全局误吸附点”；
- 测试仍输出单 embedding，避免变成 test-time trick。

廉价 kill-switch：
1. 冻结强 Swin，提 query/gallery feature。
2. 计算 `H_k(g)=# {q | g in top-k(q), y_g != y_q}`。
3. 看 false top-1 是否集中在少数高 `H_k` gallery：top 1% hub 至少吃掉 20-30% false hits 才有戏。
4. query 级 hub mass `M(q)=sum H_k(g)` 是否比 norm、top1 margin、camera pair、#gallery positives 更能解释 AP/R1 错误。
5. 零训练干预：`score' = cosine - λ log(1+H_k(g))` 或 CSLS / Mutual Proximity 类 hub 校正。若 mAP/R1 小涨，且收益集中在高 hub-mass query，方向活；若随机打乱 `H_k` 也涨，或只等价于 camera correction，杀掉。
6. 必须 Market + MSMT 至少双数据成立；occluded_duke 只能当普通 benchmark sanity，不许写遮挡故事。

撞车核查：
- k-reciprocal re-ranking 已经用 reciprocal neighbor 做 test-time ranking，但它不是把 **gallery in-degree hubness** 定义成强 ReID 的失败变量，也不是训练端 anti-hub。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1701.08398))
- Pose2ID / Feature Centralization 已经做 training-free neighbor centralization，还涉及 pose/generation，不能撞成“邻居聚合”。我们的切口必须是 **负向图库吸附点**，不是正样本中心化。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.00938))
- hubness 在通用高维检索里是成熟概念，甚至已有工作把 hubness 和 CSLS 当核心机制分析；好处是理论可借，风险是必须证明 ReID 里没人把它做成主问题。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26575))

**方向 2，备胎：Rank-Instability Adaptive ReID**
一句话：如果强 backbone 已经很强，继续卷 mAP 可能不现实；换问题轴：**不是所有 query 都需要同等计算/同等复杂匹配**。隐藏变量是 rank instability。

触发观察：
同一冻结 Swin，提多种便宜特征：低分辨率、浅层 stage、CLS/avg、final feature。若多数 query 的 cheap rank 与 full rank 高度一致，少数 query 排名剧烈变化且承包错误，就有新问题。

重定义：
ReID 当前默认 uniform inference：每个 query 都走同样 backbone、同样检索策略。实际应是 **rank-stability conditioned retrieval**：稳定 query 早退，unstable query 才走 full feature / rerank / expert。

机制怎么长：
- 多出口 Swin 或低/高分辨率 cascade；
- 用 cheap-vs-full top-k overlap、rank entropy、margin stability 作为 gating signal；
- 训练时加 rank-consistency / instability predictor；
- 目标不是单纯 mAP，而是 mAP-FLOPs Pareto 或 fixed-budget mAP。

零训练 kill-switch：
1. 冻结现有 ckpt，抽 cheap feature 和 full feature。
2. 定义 `R(q)=1-Jaccard(topK_cheap, topK_full)` 或 Kendall rank instability。
3. 分桶看：低 `R(q)` cheap≈full，高 `R(q)` full 明显救回。
4. oracle cascade：只对 top p% unstable query 用 full feature，其余用 cheap feature。若 40-60% FLOPs 下 mAP 接近 full，方向活。
5. 破坏对照：随机 p%、只用 final margin、只用 norm。如果 instability 不比这些强，杀掉。

撞车核查：
- AT-ReID 2025 的 “anytime” 是昼夜/长期/换衣多场景，不是 computational early-exit。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.16635))
- DART³ 是 camera-bias TTA，不是预算分配。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.18337))
- 风险：这更像效率/协议稿，不是纯涨点稿。只有 kill-switch 显示 Pareto 很漂亮，才值得推进。

优先级：先测 **Gallery Hubness**。它最像你们现在能做的 B 类方法稿：强 backbone 冻结就能证伪，完全绕开 SMPL/遮挡/航拍，机制也能自然从隐藏变量长出来。方向 2 只在 hubness 不成立时作为新协议备胎。

- memory bank 维护每个样本的 cross-ID top-k in-degree；
- 对“吸引很多错误身份”的 gallery 施加 anti-hub margin；
- 正常 ID loss / triplet 保留，但 negative 权重从“离 anchor 多近”改为“它是否是全局误吸附点”；
- 测试仍输出单 embedding，避免变成 test-time trick。

廉价 kill-switch：
1. 冻结强 Swin，提 query/gallery feature。
2. 计算 `H_k(g)=# {q | g in top-k(q), y_g != y_q}`。
3. 看 false top-1 是否集中在少数高 `H_k` gallery：top 1% hub 至少吃掉 20-30% false hits 才有戏。
4. query 级 hub mass `M(q)=sum H_k(g)` 是否比 norm、top1 margin、camera pair、#gallery positives 更能解释 AP/R1 错误。
5. 零训练干预：`score' = cosine - λ log(1+H_k(g))` 或 CSLS / Mutual Proximity 类 hub 校正。若 mAP/R1 小涨，且收益集中在高 hub-mass query，方向活；若随机打乱 `H_k` 也涨，或只等价于 camera correction，杀掉。
6. 必须 Market + MSMT 至少双数据成立；occluded_duke 只能当普通 benchmark sanity，不许写遮挡故事。

撞车核查：
- k-reciprocal re-ranking 已经用 reciprocal neighbor 做 test-time ranking，但它不是把 **gallery in-degree hubness** 定义成强 ReID 的失败变量，也不是训练端 anti-hub。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1701.08398))
- Pose2ID / Feature Centralization 已经做 training-free neighbor centralization，还涉及 pose/generation，不能撞成“邻居聚合”。我们的切口必须是 **负向图库吸附点**，不是正样本中心化。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.00938))
- hubness 在通用高维检索里是成熟概念，甚至已有工作把 hubness 和 CSLS 当核心机制分析；好处是理论可借，风险是必须证明 ReID 里没人把它做成主问题。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26575))

**方向 2，备胎：Rank-Instability Adaptive ReID**
一句话：如果强 backbone 已经很强，继续卷 mAP 可能不现实；换问题轴：**不是所有 query 都需要同等计算/同等复杂匹配**。隐藏变量是 rank instability。

触发观察：
同一冻结 Swin，提多种便宜特征：低分辨率、浅层 stage、CLS/avg、final feature。若多数 query 的 cheap rank 与 full rank 高度一致，少数 query 排名剧烈变化且承包错误，就有新问题。

重定义：
ReID 当前默认 uniform inference：每个 query 都走同样 backbone、同样检索策略。实际应是 **rank-stability conditioned retrieval**：稳定 query 早退，unstable query 才走 full feature / rerank / expert。

机制怎么长：
- 多出口 Swin 或低/高分辨率 cascade；
- 用 cheap-vs-full top-k overlap、rank entropy、margin stability 作为 gating signal；
- 训练时加 rank-consistency / instability predictor；
- 目标不是单纯 mAP，而是 mAP-FLOPs Pareto 或 fixed-budget mAP。

零训练 kill-switch：
1. 冻结现有 ckpt，抽 cheap feature 和 full feature。
2. 定义 `R(q)=1-Jaccard(topK_cheap, topK_full)` 或 Kendall rank instability。
3. 分桶看：低 `R(q)` cheap≈full，高 `R(q)` full 明显救回。
4. oracle cascade：只对 top p% unstable query 用 full feature，其余用 cheap feature。若 40-60% FLOPs 下 mAP 接近 full，方向活。
5. 破坏对照：随机 p%、只用 final margin、只用 norm。如果 instability 不比这些强，杀掉。

撞车核查：
- AT-ReID 2025 的 “anytime” 是昼夜/长期/换衣多场景，不是 computational early-exit。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.16635))
- DART³ 是 camera-bias TTA，不是预算分配。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.18337))
- 风险：这更像效率/协议稿，不是纯涨点稿。只有 kill-switch 显示 Pareto 很漂亮，才值得推进。

优先级：先测 **Gallery Hubness**。它最像你们现在能做的 B 类方法稿：强 backbone 冻结就能证伪，完全绕开 SMPL/遮挡/航拍，机制也能自然从隐藏变量长出来。方向 2 只在 hubness 不成立时作为新协议备胎。
